ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) distribution across the visible surface; high-intensity pixels (white) are restricted to localized surface markings and terminal tips, resulting in an estimated macro-ratio of approximately 0.05:0.95.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across the majority of the fluke; high-contrast contiguous white clusters are concentrated at the far lateral distal tips; multiple discrete linear high-intensity streaks observed in the lower-left and lower-right ventral quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central indentation with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 30% of the vertical lobe height from base to peak.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the trailing edge; peaks and valleys exhibit variable amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels; frequency is highest along the mid-section of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory extending from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, upward-turned points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast pixel formations (barnacle colonies) localized specifically on the extreme outer tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned white linear pixel disruptions; notably a set of parallel diagonal marks on the left lobe and scattered horizontal marks on the right lobe, characteristic of tooth rake scars.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive encrustation of acorn barnacles at the distal tips; multiple visible linear rake marks (scars) breaking the dark ventral pigmentation.
